segments.name: Protective films
segments.description: Supplies protective films, coatings and installation services to automobile aftermarket installers, new car dealerships, OEMs and architectural customers.
segments.evidence: As a result, these segments have been aggregated into a single reportable segment in accordance with the aggregation criteria under ASC 280, Segment Reporting.

revenueModel.text: Independent installers, new car dealerships, distributors, Company-owned centers, OEMs and online buyers pay for films, installation services and software access.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell and distribute our products through independent installers, new car dealerships, third-party distributors, Company-owned installation centers, OEMs, Protex Canada's franchisees, and online.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company restructured segment reporting to geographically segmented business units, which were then aggregated into a single reportable segment.
changes.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company restructured its reporting to the CODM to include financial information from geographically segmented business units.
